summary: Session F-47 completed the EXEPACK stub reverse-engineering to instruction level and resolved the F-46 blocking unknown: the long-run 'distance' is a 16-bit offset whose non-wrapping case reads FORWARD into the moved copy of the packed stream itself (the packer's LZ dictionary includes its own output); the F-46 56-variant brute force failed because only backward formulas were tried. Sliding-copy semantics, NORM as physical-preserving window slide, and the DONE/reloc path are now fully documented. Exact-machine simulation decodes the flag stream to token 2759 (~19.3KB image) then hits a c==0 END while the entry demands image offset 0x13600 (79,744B); the residual 44.5KB payload as fresh sections is disproven. Single remaining unknown: why true flag reads diverge from pristine payload after ~19KB. Opcode table still unpinned; F-41/F-53 envelope + type table stand.

Entry = image offset 0x13600 (79,744 B)

token_grammar.bitstream: 16-bit LE flag words (lodsw), LSB-first (shr bp,1); raw bytes/words share SI
token_grammar.short_run: bits 0,0 then 2 count bits (first bit = high bit via rcl cx,1 twice) -> count = bits+2 (2..5); 1 raw byte; BX = 0xFF00|byte (dist = 0x100-byte, 1..256)
token_grammar.long_run: bits 0,1 then raw word w; BX = ((0xE0|((w>>8)>>3))<<8)|(w&0xFF); count-code (w>>8)&7: nonzero -> count = code+2 (3..9); zero -> raw c-byte: 0=END, 1=NORM, >=2 -> count = c+1 (3..256)
token_grammar.copy_semantics: SLIDING: loop of mov al,es:[bx+di] / stosb — source advances with destination (LZ77 overlapping copy; dist < count repeats)
token_grammar.source_resolution: src = (BX+DI) mod 0x10000. Wrapped (BX+DI >= 0x10000): backward into decoded output, dist = 0x10000-BX <= 0x2000 (8KB window). NON-wrapped: FORWARD read of the moved stream copy at stream offset (DI+BX-0x7E10) — the packer self-references its final packed output (literals double as dictionary); valid past or future relative to SI
token_grammar.norm_marker: c==1: DI := 0x2000+(DI&0xF); ES += (DI>>4)-0x200; SI := SI&0xF; DS += SI_old>>4 — physical addresses preserved exactly; holds DI ~0x2000 so all dists up to 0x2000 resolve without segment underflow; first observed NORM at DI=0x1A15 (es dips 0x5F paras below image base, unreferenced slack)
token_grammar.verification: tokens 1-36 reproduce the F-46 prefix exactly (Borland OVERLAY ENTRY STUBS: mov ax,[0x44]/or ax,[0x42]/je/push [0x44]/push [0x42]/push cs/call/retf — image offset 0 is not C0 for this binary); sibling EXEs open with flag word 0xFFFF + clean C0 literals 55 8B EC B8 ... ; all four binaries hit the same non-wrapping forward-read case early (DI 16..42)
